summary: Batch fresh work-owner and pinned mission-definition reads in reconciliation

schema.detail: No table, index, trigger, claim kind or storage version change.

rules.detail: Effective run/generation/root state, lease expiry, person blockers, queue and timeout fields, handoff and responses retain their existing rules. Runtime/effect authority guards and launch dispatch are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: All current-generation work including terminal steps remains eligible for the same ordered view and wake closure. Owner reads deduplicate exact run/generation pairs within the invocation and use groups of at most 128 supplied contexts; pinned definitions are read once per distinct generation and parsed once per invocation after releasing the read snapshot. One clock per call is retained. Missing owner/definition rows remain optional as before and malformed definitions refuse the whole result. Multiple simultaneous storage errors can change diagnostic precedence or column numbers; no partial vector is returned. Each call reads fresh database inputs, with no retained context or authority reuse.

downtime.detail: Removes repeated per-step owner queries and repeated pinned-definition queries and JSON parsing from work reconciliation. Synthetic parity, boundary, indexed-plan and whole-read SQL/VM controls are included; production SQL-per-minute, phase share, CPU, latency and snapshot duration remain unmeasured until qualification and the single capture after deployment.

manual.detail: No new manual steps or configuration.

recovery.detail: The reader writes no state. Source rollback restores the previous per-step reader without a migration.
